You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: On 16 January 2027, can machinery conforming to Directive 2006/42/EC still be placed on the market?

Facts:
[0] products placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC — placingAllowedUntil — 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) [condition: placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC before 14 January 2027] [CORR, Corrigendum, point 6]
[1] Chapter VI of this Regulation (mutatis mutandis to such products) — appliesFrom — 19 July 2023 (2023-07-19) [condition: mutatis mutandis to such products instead of Article 11 of that Directive, including products for which a procedure has already been initiated under Article 11 of Directive 2006/42/EC] [CORR, Corrigendum, point 7]
[2] Directive 2006/42/EC — repealedFrom — 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 5]
[3] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product (for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product) [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[4] technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or the related product has been placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Art. 10(3)]
[5] copy of the EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 13(8)]
[6] machinery CE marking date — hasObligation — It is prohibited to pre-date or post-date the machinery (it is prohibited to pre-date or post-date the machinery) [condition: when affixing the CE marking] [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.3]
[7] portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery — placingAllowedUntil — Until 29 June 2011 (2011-06-29) [condition: which are in conformity with the national provisions in force upon adoption of this Directive] [DIR, Art. 27]
[8] manufacturer — hasObligation — shall cease the placing on the market of the machinery concerned (cease the placing on the market of the machinery concerned) [condition: In the event that the validity of the EC-type examination certificate is not renewed] [DIR, Annex IX]
[9] technical documentation and EU declaration of incorporation — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 11(3)]
[10] digital EU declarations of incorporation — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(8)]
[11] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity (EU declaration of conformity) [condition: Before making machinery or a related product available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[12] manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative — hasObligation — shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that (shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that) [condition: before placing it on the market] [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[13] partly completed machinery — hasObligation — must not be put into service (must not be put into service) [condition: until the final machinery into which it is to be incorporated has been declared in conformity with the provisions of this Directive, where appropriate] [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[14] category of machinery or related product not fulfilling points (a) to (d) — listedIn — Annex I, Part B (annex i, part b) [condition: does not fulfil one or more of the conditions in points (a) to (d)] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[15] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall ensure that the procedure referred to in Article 13 has been completed (shall ensure that the procedure referred to in article 13 has been completed) [condition: before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 5(2)]
[16] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — EU type-examination (module B) (eu type-examination (module b)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[17] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — ensure that the technical file referred to in Annex VII, part A is available (ensure that the technical file referred to in annex vii, part a is available) [condition: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service] [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[18] digital assembly instructions made accessible online — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[19] copy of EU type-examination certificate, annexes, additions and technical documentation kept by manufacturer — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Annex VII, 7]
[20] manufacturers — hasObligation — affix the CE marking in accordance with Article 24 (affix the ce marking in accordance with article 24) [condition: Where compliance of machinery or a related product with the essential health and safety requirements laid down in Annex III has been demonstrated by that conformity assessment procedure] [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[21] technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the product has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 12(2)]
[22] importers of machinery and related products — hasObligation — shall place only compliant machinery (shall place only compliant machinery) [REG, Art. 13(1)]
[23] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — EU type-examination (module B) (eu type-examination (module b)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[24] category of machinery or related product — listedIn — Annex I, Part A (annex i, part a) [condition: if, according to the assessment referred to in paragraph 4, and taking into account the available information, it presents a serious inherent potential risk, and one or more of the following conditions is fulfilled] [REG, Art. 6(7)]
[25] manufacturers — hasObligation — Manufacturers shall ensure (manufacturers shall ensure that the machinery or related product is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity) [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[26] copy of EU declaration of incorporation, kept by importers — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 14(7)]
[27] machinery or related product — mustAccompany — EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A (EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V, Part A) [condition: or alternatively, internet address or machine-readable code where that EU declaration of conformity can be accessed in the instructions for use] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[28] machinery category not designed per harmonised standards — requiresProcedure — shall apply one of the procedures referred to in points (b), (c) or (d) (shall apply one of the procedures referred to in points (b), (c) or (d)) [condition: the machinery or related product was not designed and constructed in accordance with the harmonised standards] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[29] digital instructions, manufacturer — retentionPeriod — make them accessible online during the expected lifetime (for at least 10 years) [condition: after the placing on the market of the machinery or related product] [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[30] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall draw up the EU declaration of incorporation in accordance with Article 22 (shall draw up the eu declaration of incorporation in accordance with article 22) [condition: Where compliance of partly completed machinery with the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III has been demonstrated in the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part B] [REG, Art. 11(2)]
[31] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall apply one of the following procedures (shall apply one of the following procedures) [condition: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2), and provided that those standards cover all of the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[32] category of machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) (conformity to type based on internal production control (module c)) [condition: followed by EU type-examination (module B), under option (a)] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[33] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed (shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed) [condition: When placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 11(1)]
[34] manufacturers — hasObligation — draw up the EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 21 (draw up the eu declaration of conformity in accordance with article 21) [condition: Where compliance of machinery or a related product with the essential health and safety requirements laid down in Annex III has been demonstrated by that conformity assessment procedure] [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[35] relevant technical documentation for partly completed machinery — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [DIR, Annex VII]
[36] importer of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall not place it on the market until it has been brought into conformity (shall not place it on the market until it has been brought into conformity) [condition: Where an importer considers or has reason to believe that partly completed machinery is not in conformity with this Regulation] [REG, Art. 14(2)]
[37] categories of machinery and related products — listedIn — listed in Annex I (listed in annex i) [REG, Art. 6(4)]
[38] importers — hasObligation — shall ensure that the appropriate conformity assessment procedures (shall ensure that the appropriate conformity assessment procedures) [condition: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market] [REG, Art. 13(2)]
[39] machinery — mustAccompany — EC declaration of conformity (ec declaration of conformity) [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[40] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) (conformity to type based on internal production control (module c)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[41] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall apply one of the following procedures (shall apply one of the following procedures) [condition: Where the machinery is referred to in Annex IV and has not been manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2)] [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[42] manufacturers — hasObligation — shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed (shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed) [condition: When placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service] [REG, Art. 10(1)]
[43] machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(3) (specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in article 25(3)) [REG, Art. 6(1)]
[44] machinery and related products in categories listed in Annex I, Part A — requiresProcedure — specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 25(2) (specific conformity assessment procedures referred to in article 25(2)) [REG, Art. 6(1)]
[45] importers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall place only compliant partly completed machinery (shall place only compliant partly completed machinery) [REG, Art. 14(1)]
[46] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements (ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements) [condition: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service] [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[47] importer of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall inform the manufacturer and the market surveillance authorities (shall inform the manufacturer and the market surveillance authorities) [condition: where the partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards the relevant essential health and safety requirements] [REG, Art. 14(2)]
[48] distributors — hasObligation — bears the CE marking (bears the CE marking) [condition: Before making machinery or a related product available on the market] [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[49] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall keep the technical documentation (shall keep the technical documentation and the EU declaration of incorporation at the disposal of the market surveillance authorities) [REG, Art. 11(3)]

response.text: {"kind":"boolean","value":false,"text":"Directive 2006/42/EC is repealed only from 20 January 2027 (Corrigendum, point 5), so it is still in force on 16 January 2027. The allowance to place products on the market until 20 January 2027 covers only products placed on the market in conformity with the Directive before 14 January 2027 (Corrigendum, point 6). Machinery first placed on the market on 16 January 2027 does not meet that condition, so it can no longer be placed on the market under the Directive. This is an inference from the facts, which do not say this outright.","used":[0,2]}
